_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: receipt_line_options
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (receipt_id, line_position) REFERENCES receipt_lines (receipt_id, position)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "business" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "address_lines" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "vat_id" TEXT NULL, "receipt_footer" TEXT NULL, "logo_file_id" TEXT NULL, "logo_path" TEXT NULL, "logo_color" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "tax_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deposit_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "info" TEXT NULL, "template_id" TEXT NULL, "favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favorite" IN (0, 1)), "in_sale" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("in_sale" IN (0, 1)), "photo_path" TEXT NULL, "photo_file_id" TEXT NULL, "photo_color" TEXT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "modifier_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "modifier_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES modifier_templates (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "min_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "max_count" INTEGER NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "modifier_options" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES modifier_groups (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "surcharge_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "tax_percent" INTEGER NULL, "deposit_cents" INTEGER NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "staff" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "pin_salt" TEXT NOT NULL, "pin_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cash_drawer_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("cash_drawer_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "show_images" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("show_images" IN (0, 1)), "theme_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "void_requires_chef" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("void_requires_chef" IN (0, 1)), "receipt_draft" TEXT NULL, "printer_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "printer_address" TEXT NULL, "printer_name" TEXT NULL, "printer_columns" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 48, "printer_qr_as_image" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("printer_qr_as_image" IN (0, 1)), "language" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'de', "kitchen_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'off', "kitchen_language" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'de', "kitchen_printer_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "kitchen_printer_address" TEXT NULL, "kitchen_printer_name" TEXT NULL, "kitchen_printer_columns" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 48, "kitchen_skip_categories" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "split_payment" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("split_payment" IN (0, 1)), "card_tip" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("card_tip" IN (0, 1)), "discount_access" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'off', "open_amount_access" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'off', "deposit_return_access" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'off', "voucher" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("voucher" IN (0, 1)), "invoice" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("invoice" IN (0, 1)), "receipt_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'alwaysPrint', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "translations" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL, "values_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "business_days" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "opened_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NULL, "opening_float_cents" INTEGER NULL, "counted_cents" INTEGER NULL, "left_in_drawer_cents" INTEGER NULL, "expected_cents" INTEGER NULL, "difference_cents" INTEGER NULL, "closed_by_name" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cash_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "business_day_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES business_days (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "staff_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "staff_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "staff_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "staff_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "business_day_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES business_days (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "voids_receipt_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES receipts (id), "goods_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deposit_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tip_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_percent" INTEGER NULL, "discount_amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_reason" TEXT NULL, "public_token" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipt_lines" ("receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES receipts (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "info" TEXT NULL, "unit_price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_deposit_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gross20_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "gross10_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "gross13_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "gross0_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "gross19_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "own_discount_percent" INTEGER NULL, "own_discount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "own_discount_reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("receipt_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipt_line_options" ("receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "line_position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "group_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "option_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "surcharge_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("receipt_id", "line_position", "position"), FOREIGN KEY (receipt_id, line_position) REFERENCES receipt_lines (receipt_id, position));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES receipts (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "given_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "change_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "provider" TEXT NULL, "provider_tx_code" TEXT NULL, "card_scheme" TEXT NULL, "card_last4" TEXT NULL, "tip_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tip_staff_id" TEXT NULL, "tip_staff_name" TEXT NULL, "voucher_id" TEXT NULL, "voucher_code" TEXT NULL, "voucher_balance_after_cents" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("receipt_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_card_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cart_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "staff_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "staff_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "cash_part_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tip_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "register_id" TEXT NULL, "register_name" TEXT NULL, "business_id" TEXT NULL, "pull_cursor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "initial_pull_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("initial_pull_done" IN (0, 1)), "last_pull_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "blocked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("blocked" IN (0, 1)), "device_id" TEXT NULL, "last_push_at" INTEGER NULL, "photos_auto_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("photos_auto_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "catch_up_pending" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("catch_up_pending" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rksv_certificates" ("serial_hex" TEXT NOT NULL, "certificate" BLOB NOT NULL, "issuers" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("serial_hex"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rksv_chains" ("chain" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'probe', "cash_box_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "zda_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cert_serial" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rksv_certificates (serial_hex), "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("chain"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rksv_entries" ("chain" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES rksv_chains (chain), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES receipts (id), "jws" TEXT NOT NULL, "damaged" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("damaged" IN (0, 1)), "cert_serial" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("chain", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rksv_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'off', "chain" INTEGER NULL, "counter_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "outage_since" INTEGER NULL, "outage_reason" TEXT NULL, "tasks" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "notice" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "field" TEXT NULL, "value" TEXT NULL, "changed_at" INTEGER NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "reason" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reports" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "app_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "android_version" TEXT NULL, "device_model" TEXT NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "signature" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vouchers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sold_receipt_id" TEXT NULL, "sold_line_position" INTEGER NULL, "is_test" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_test" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "voucher_movements" ("voucher_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("voucher_id", "receipt_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "address_line1" TEXT NOT NULL, "address_line2" TEXT NOT NULL, "vat_id" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_used_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipt_recipients" ("receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "address_line1" TEXT NOT NULL, "address_line2" TEXT NOT NULL, "vat_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "staff_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "staff_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("receipt_id", "version"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipt_deliveries" ("receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("receipt_id", "kind"));
CREATE INDEX vouchers_code ON vouchers (code)
